146.news_title: Arcooda's 29-inch 4:3 Monitor - Designed for the Arcade Industry
146.long_description:
As previously announced, a 29-inch 4:3 aspect ratio LCD monitor has been undergoing testing in order to effectively provide a modern option for gamers feeling nostalgic for the retro style of monitor. This current prototype promises to deliver the iconic 4:3 aspect ratio alongside a 29-inch size, providing an effective solution that combines the nostalgic qualities of classic CRT monitors with the modern advancement of today's technology.

For some time now, the arcade gaming industry has experienced a lower amount of CRT monitors, with many people going for the option of purchasing older, cheaper ones that are at the end of their lives. We at Arcooda seek to improve on the arcade industry itself, by promising to deliver an option to continue high quality retro gaming in modern times. A main priority for us is to make a product that not only serves you high quality experiences but has an extensive life which we assist in maintaining through long-term support and assistance.
